Initiate at REDUCE with a Fair Value of Rs 2,350.
Caplin Point is a high-quality business
trading at a price that assumes it is a materially better one. FY26 delivered revenue of Rs
21.9bn (+12.9%) and PAT of Rs 6.5bn (+20.1%) at a 38.1% EBITDA margin, 20.6% RoE and
zero net debt. Our objection is not to the franchise. It is that between FY22 and FY26 profit
compounded at 20.5% while free cash flow compounded at
~20x to 30x forward earnings into that divergence.

Management points to a large El Salvador tender requiring 60-day supply, Rs 40-50 crore of

the company has also widened its own comfort band from "100-120 days" to "100-130 days" -

Growth is decelerating exactly where it matters most
The RoW business - Latin America plus Francophone Africa, 78% of revenue - grew just
in FY26, and Q4 flattered by roughly Rs 50-55 crore of one-off tender supply. Caplin
Steriles (US, 21% of revenue) remains the genuine engine: revenue Rs 4.7bn (+28.6%),
EBITDA margin up 230bps to 30.2%, own-label revenue at ~Rs 1.0bn and profitable in its first
full year. Management guides to 25-30% CSL growth and a doubling of own-label in FY27,
but also asks investors to "be patient for the next 12-to-18 months" on Latin America. We
model a 14.5% revenue and 13.3% PAT CAGR over FY26-29E.
Execution is excellent internally, chronically late externally
Where Caplin controls the outcome it delivers: Rs 2.5bn of FY26 capex funded debt-free from
internal accruals, margins held, and a US front-end profitable in year one without
cannibalising B2B. Where regulators and construction intervene, it slips 2-4 quarters with
unusual consistency - Thervoy oncology API moved from Q4FY26 to Q4FY27, Puducherry
OSD from Q3FY27 to Q1FY28. The "$100mn Caplin Steriles run-rate", live since around
Add 2-4 quarters to every forward date

Technical position: extended, trendless and coiled into an event
All moving averages are stacked bullishly and the price sits above every one of them - textbook stage-two structure. But ADX at 17.8 is below the 20
threshold that defines a trend, volume over the last five sessions has run at 0.44-0.58x the ten-day average, and each rally into Rs 2,640-2,700 has been
sold. The 27 July session (+6.25% on 3.6x volume) marked a real buyer; nothing since has confirmed it. This is a consolidation into the 12 August result,

Caplin Point Laboratories carries a blended Fair Value of Rs 2,350 against a current price of Rs 2,586, an expected return of (9.1)%. This sits at the boundary of REDUCE and SELL; we adopt
REDUCE because our objection is to the entry price rather than to the franchise, and because we would be buyers in size below Rs 2,150.
